{"base":"main","body":"This is a feature release (v2.14.0) headlined by a new Grok Build provider, plus a cross-provider normalization of `--debug-raw` output and a couple of correctness fixes. The range spans 52 non-merge commits and 111 files (+12,389/−441) from `origin/main` to `origin/dev`.\n\n## Highlights\n\n- **New provider: Grok Build.** Full save/resume/cloud-sync support for xAI's Grok Build CLI (sessions from `1.0.34`+), on par with the other nine supported agents. Resume works both ways between Grok Build and other providers.\n- **`specstory run` default fixed.** Bare `specstory run` now launches Claude Code as documented instead of whichever provider happened to be registered first alphabetically; help text and the configured default now agree.\n- **`--debug-raw` normalized across every JSONL provider.** Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor CLI, Droid CLI, Gemini CLI, Muse Code, Pi, Antigravity CLI, and Grok Build now share common `spi.WriteDebugRecords` / `spi.PrepareDebugDir` helpers, refresh exports consistently, and preserve unknown native fields.\n- **`NEW-PROVIDER-GUIDE.md` gets two new required sections**: separating `testdata/` (test-consumed fixtures) from `examples/` (human-review evidence), and a \"Native debug output\" contract every provider must satisfy.\n- Four dependabot updates (Go module + GitHub Actions) merged via the automated dependency-update workflow, each with a recorded assessment.\n\n## Major Change Areas\n\n### Grok Build provider (specstory-cli/pkg/providers/grokbuild)\nNew package (~5,700 lines including tests, fixtures, and examples) implementing the full SPI contract: JSONL parsing (`jsonl_parser.go`), session reconstruction (`reconstruct.go`), markdown tool rendering (`markdown_tools.go`), a restartable watcher that drains final writes without relying on clock comparisons, path/discovery utilities scoped strictly to the native store layout, and factory scripts (`install`, `latest-version`, `list-tools`) for the software-factory pipeline. Design and format are documented in `GROK-FORMAT.md`; the extensive `docs/GROK-REVIEW.md` (new, 150+ lines, appended to again in this range) records a line-by-line implementation/QA review with 54 numbered fixes and explicit evidence for review decisions — malformed summary timestamp fallback, rejection of linked/unusable transcripts, UUID identity handling, concurrent-summary no-clobber behavior, tool-result whitespace preservation, and (most recently) preserving explicit-`null` tool parameters and verifying path-rejection behavior. The provider is wired into the registry (`pkg/spi/factory/registry.go`), config (`grok_cmd`, default `\"grok\"`), the TUI session browser (new magenta accent color, chosen because xAI's black/white brand is invisible on some terminal themes), and both READMEs.\n\n### Cross-provider `--debug-raw` refactor (226636b, d0f09a3)\n`pkg/spi/path_utils.go` gains shared primitives: `IsNumberedDebugFile`, `PrepareDebugDir` (clears only provider-owned files, preserving `session-data.json`), `WriteDebugRecords[T]` (generic numbered/pretty-printed export), and `WriteDebugJSONL`. Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor CLI, Droid CLI, Gemini CLI, Muse Code, Pi, DeepSeek TUI, and Antigravity CLI all move onto these helpers, replacing ad hoc per-provider cleanup/write logic. Antigravity's debug export now also copies async task logs into `tasks/` under their original names and refreshes the accepted-transcript export from the same parse snapshot rather than a second file read. `specstory-cli/README.md`'s `--debug-raw` section and directory diagram are rewritten to describe the unified behavior per provider.\n\n### CLI default-provider fix (1fb5ec2)\n`main.go` and `pkg/spi/factory/registry.go` previously derived the \"bare `specstory run`\" target from `registry.ListIDs()[0]`, which tracked registration order rather than an intentional default. A new `factory.DefaultProviderID` constant (`\"claude\"`) is now the single source of truth, used both for the help text's default-agent name and the actual dispatch when no provider ID is given.\n\n### Documentation (NEW-PROVIDER-GUIDE.md, NEW-PROVIDER-REVIEW.md)\nTwo structural additions to the provider-authoring guide: a \"Separate test fixtures from examples\" section requiring every `testdata/` fixture to have a real automated consumer (with review-only artifacts moved to `examples/`, following Pi's layout), and a \"Native debug output\" section specifying `--debug-raw` behavior (write under `spi.GetDebugDir`, honor `--debug-dir`, numbered pretty-printed files in source order, refresh/cleanup semantics, and required tests). The provider checklist gained matching checkboxes. `README.md` (repo root) and `specstory-cli/README.md` add Grok Build to the provider tables, diagrams, and config reference.\n\n## Dependency Updates\n\n- #328 `anthropics/claude-code-action` 1.0.230 → 1.0.231 (actions-minor-patch group) — merge — [assessment](https://github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/pull/328#issuecomment-5772666792)\n- #326 `modernc.org/sqlite` 1.58.0 → 1.59.0 (specstory-cli) — merge — [assessment](https://github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/pull/326#issuecomment-5756874119)\n- #327 actions-minor-patch group, 3 updates across 1 directory — merge — [assessment](https://github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/pull/327#issuecomment-5756852440)\n- #323 `github.com/posthog/posthog-go` 1.25.1 → 1.25.2 (specstory-cli) — merge — [assessment](https://github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/pull/323#issuecomment-5726615911)\n\n## Operational Notes\n\n- **Three-platform support**: the Grok Build provider is subject to the same macOS/Linux/Windows CI matrix as other providers; `docs/GROK-REVIEW.md` notes live verification was performed on macOS arm64 only, with native media and scheduler-mutation success paths unverified because the reviewed run exhausted the test account's Grok allowance before those calls — worth a follow-up pass before broad rollout if those paths matter to users.\n- **Config surface change**: `[providers]` gains `grok_cmd` (default `\"grok\"`); no removals or behavior changes for existing keys, so existing config files remain valid.\n- **`--debug-raw` output layout changes** for +// blobDebugName preserves DAG position and native row identity; index zero
+// names an orphan, which has no position in the connected conversation.
+func blobDebugName(index, rowID int) string {
+	if index == 0 {
+		return fmt.Sprintf("orphan-%d.json", rowID)
+	}
+	return fmt.Sprintf("%d-%d.json", index, rowID)
+}
+
+// isBlobDebugName accepts only names the writer generates. Round-tripping
+// through blobDebugName keeps cleanup in sync with the filename format.
+func isBlobDebugName(name string) bool {
+	stem, ok := strings.CutSuffix(name, ".json")
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	prefix, row, ok := strings.Cut(stem, "-")
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	index := 0
+	if prefix != "orphan" {
+		var err error
+		index, err = strconv.Atoi(prefix)
+		if err != nil || index <= 0 {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	rowID, err := strconv.Atoi(row)
+	return err == nil && name == blobDebugName(index, rowID)
+}
